previous_versions.body: Should we limit the generator to CSPRNG? There are generators that are enforced but not specified as CSPRNG, such as SecureRandom in Java. The attack to randomness of lookup secrets needs many samples, which is too difficult for attackers to obtain, so I suggest softer specification such as "using secure generators".
